name: Hacienda AltaGracia, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This former coffee plantation turned luxury sanctuary sits on 180 pristine acres where the Costa Rican mountains meet the valley, offering an authentic farm-to-table experience in one of the world's most biodiverse regions.
whats_special: Hacienda AltaGracia occupies a historic 1920s coffee estate where guests can still walk among working coffee fields. The property features its own equestrian center with rescued horses, an organic farm supplying the restaurants, and casitas designed to blend seamlessly with the natural landscape. The resort sits at 4,000 feet elevation, providing cooler mountain air and stunning views of the Talamanca range.
pro_tip: Book the coffee plantation tour at sunrise - you'll witness the harvest process firsthand and enjoy freshly roasted beans while watching the mist lift from the valley below.
dont_miss: The nearby Los Cusingos Bird Sanctuary, former home of renowned ornithologist Dr. Alexander Skutch, offers some of Costa Rica's best birdwatching with over 200 species. The property is also your gateway to Chirripó National Park, home to Costa Rica's highest peak and the only place in the country where you might see frost.
pros: Stunning mountain views and pristine natural setting in Costa Rica's highlands
Luxury hacienda-style architecture with authentic colonial charm
World-class spa and wellness facilities with holistic treatments
Exceptional farm-to-table dining featuring local Costa Rican ingredients
cons: Remote mountain location requires significant travel time from major airports
Limited nightlife and urban amenities due to secluded natural setting
